# Best MagSafe car mounts (Qi2)

**Best for most iPhone drivers: Belkin BoostCharge Qi2 15W Vent Mount, about $47.99**
- Three of the roundups pick it as best overall ([RottenWiFi](https://rottenwifi.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/), [iTechGuides](https://www.itechguides.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/), [CloudsPress](https://www.cloudspress.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/)).
- It includes a 27W car adapter and a USB-C cable, and rotates between portrait and landscape.
- Check your vents first. Belkin specifies slats up to 3 mm thick and 20 mm deep. Straight horizontal slats work best, and vertical ones can droop.
- A Belkin vent/dash version exists if your vents are a poor fit.

**Best for fastest charging and reliability: Anker Prime Qi2 25W (AirCool), about $89.99**
- It has thermoelectric cooling plus a fan, which helps on hot days. MountGuys uses it as their own daily driver ([MountGuys](https://www.mountguys.com/best-magsafe-car-mount/)).
- It is the priciest pick. The Gadgeteer lists it discounted to $69.99 ([The Gadgeteer](https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/)).
- 25W only applies to newer phones: iPhone 17 and 16 Pro Max/Plus get up to 25W, and iPhone 15 and earlier get about 15W.
- It is not compatible with Tesla or Mercedes-Benz vents.
- The sources disagree on the power adapter. Some say a 60W adapter is in the box, others say you need your own 45W+ adapter. Confirm on the listing.

**Best value with cooling: ESR HaloLock Qi2 15W with CryoBoost**
- It has a built-in fan to prevent heat throttling, and mounts on a vent or dash ([The Gadgeteer](https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/)).
- Dealectric lists it at $39.99. With code **PARTNER18** it comes to **$32.80**, tested in ESR's cart on 2026-10-25 ([Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/)).
- **Buy link:** https://dealectric.com/go/esr-halolock-15w-wireless-car-charger-cryoboost. Dealectric is paid if you buy through this link, at no extra cost to you.
- The Gadgeteer's Amazon price is lower, but it quotes two different figures ($35.99 and $18.99), so compare before buying. Their 18W car adapter isn't included, which can add $10 to $15.

**Other options**
- **LISEN Qi2.2 25W with fan, from $39.95:** includes a 95W adapter, so it's good for iPhone 16/17 owners.
- **PITAKA MagEZ Car Mount Pro 2, $59.99:** nicest design, but no fan, so it may throttle in direct sun.
- **Budget:** LISEN 15W (about $15.99) and ESR 15W (about $19.99) are on Amazon, per the roundups.

**Quick tips**
- Buy Qi2-certified. "MagSafe-compatible" alone can mean only 7.5W.
- Use a strong USB-C PD car adapter (30W+ for 25W charging).
- Ignore marketing figures like "80 lb suction." Those usually describe the dash cup, not the magnet.

I only have a direct purchase link for the ESR. For the Belkin, Anker, and others, the Amazon links are on the review pages above. Tell me your phone model and vent or dash type and I can narrow it to one pick.
